title: MI v3 — SEALED prospective flags (acute pre-turn signature, 2024 baseline)
status: SEALED — frozen before outcomes; do not re-tune. Score out once WGI ~2028 is published (~2030).
model: MI v3 (equal weights + consolidated-pair caution); data = WGI 2025-anchored, 180-country panel.
method: Acute pre-turn signature = P1 down >=0.03 AND pillar spread widening >=0.03 since 2018, from a non-floor level (P1>0.33). The framework's acute-timing horizon is ~3-5y (mi.constants.LEAD_TIME); these are directional RISK flags, NOT dated forecasts (Mod8).
calibration_caveat: Acute horizon calibrated on n=2 turns (Chile 2019, Lebanon 2019) -> preliminary. These flags are the out-of-sample test of that horizon.

United States.prediction: Elevated risk of a stability/cohesion shock or contested institutional episode (managed instability) within the window — NOT state fragmentation or collapse (P3/P4 remain high). If the flag is real, expect P5 (stability) to keep falling and the pillar spread to keep widening.
United States.falsification_condition: FALSE POSITIVE if, by the score-out, P5 has RECOVERED toward its 2018 level AND the spread has NARROWED, with no notable national instability/cohesion episode in 2025-2029.
United States.watch_signal: P5 (political stability/cohesion) trajectory + pillar spread (the Chile-2019 signature); economy (P4) staying high while P1/P5 fall is the tell.

Russia.prediction: Continued institutional stagnation at/near the floor; elevated fragmentation/violence risk under shock; recovery unlikely without institutional change. (Mod8: risk, not agency or timing.)
Russia.falsification_condition: FLAG WRONG if, by the score-out, P1 has MATERIALLY RECOVERED (>= +0.05 toward the median) AND the spread has narrowed.
Russia.watch_signal: P1 floor persistence + spread; for Russia, ignore the war-economy P4 (2024-GDP-gap artifact) and read P1/P5.
